text:
Carmen (Partnerships): Quick sync  contractor SIs joining pilot next month. Two asks: background vetting checklist + short-term access model for partner contractors.
Joel (SI Program): For vetting, propose: corporate reference, SOC2 attestation, and contractor NDAs. Keep it light for pilot.
Aria (Training Ops): Access model: ephemeral lab creds + proctor-mediated exam. We can issue 6hr tokens via lab-provisioner.
Vik (HW Partnerships): HW partner (TitanEdge) can loan 2x A30 nodes for the pilot. Need tenant IDs 72h prior.
legal-bot: Note: contractors require a streamlined DPA addendum and NDA signature. Legal will prep a short-form addendum.
lms-bot: Template: contractor consent + training waiver uploaded at https://intranet.redwood/lms/si-contractor-templates-v1
Carmen (Partnerships): Action items: Joel -> publish contractor onboarding checklist; Aria -> create exam VM + 6hr token flow; Vik -> confirm TitanEdge window; legal-bot -> short addendum.
Joel (SI Program): Roger. Also proposing a lightweight "contractor badge" for pilot completion (no public listing). Will add to playbook.
Aria (Training Ops): I'll embed the badge rubric in the VM README to make proctoring consistent. Example check: listing passes sandbox validator -> proctor verifies token.
Carmen (Partnerships): If any blockers on TitanEdge, fallback to shared cloud instances. Will post final checklist here once all green.
